text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon becomes the talk of the 
town after showing a magnificent run in 
her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She vows to improve even further toward 
achieving the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was an Umamusume watching Mihono 
Bourbon's race with utmost seriousness. 
Her name was Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To her, Mihono Bourbon, who brought smiles 
to the spectators' faces, became an idol 
to look up to.
